# f5xc_rate_limiter (Resource)

A rate_limiter specifies a list of rate limit unit periods and the corresponding value of the total number of requests to be allowed in that period. It<br>also contains an optional reference to a user_identification object which determines how the user identifier for rate limiting is obtained from the input<br>fields extracted from the request.

To get more information about f5xc_rate_limiter, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/rate-limiter)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Rate Limiter - Full

resource "f5xc_rate_limiter" "example" {
  name        = "example-ratelimiter"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Full rate limiter example"

  limits = [{
    total_number = 100
    unit         = ["MINUTE"]

    burst_multiplier = 2

    action_choice = {
      disabled = true
    }
  }]

  labels = {
    env = "example"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform-team"
  }
}
```
